description:
Create and change the workspace's brand kits (editors and admins). The same operations as the brand kit page, so a kit made here looks the same there.

Actions:
- "create": a kit from `url` (reads the site's logos, colors, fonts and icons; company details are researched in the background and land in about a minute), or blank with clearly marked placeholders. `name` is optional.
- "preview_fill": what `url` would give kit `kit_id`, and which of its sections are still placeholders. Changes nothing.
- "fill": apply it. `replace` lists sections that take the site's version (company, logos, colors (or palette), fonts, icons, reference_images, guidelines); empty means the placeholder sections, so the user's own uploads and edits stay. `add` (logos, reference_images) keeps the kit's items and adds the site's. The reply's `applied` names the sections that changed.
- "update": `changes`, only what is given changes: name, palette {background,text,accent,accent2, notes {role: {name,usage}} (a color's name and how to use it)}, fonts {display,heading,subheading,paragraph,mono} (a family per type-scale role), icons {library,style}, company {one_liner,audience,problem,key_features}, overview, tone_of_voice, guidelines {recommendations,restrictions}, add_logo {url,kind,for_background}, remove_logo_id, primary_logo_id, captions (a caption style object, as a clip's subtitle_settings.subtitlesStyle or get_design_guide brand.captions gives it), voices {language: {code, engine} | null} (a default kit's voices are the workspace's default voices).
- "set_default": make `kit_id` the workspace default.
- "research": redo the company research from the kit's site.
- "dark_logo": make a version of the kit's light-background logo `logo_id` for dark backgrounds and use it. `mode` "white" is the mark in white (instant); "recolor" is an AI redraw that keeps its colors (about 30 seconds, budgeted per workspace). A logo that can't be made white says why: try recolor, or ask the user for a file.
- "delete": delete kit `kit_id`; projects that used it follow the workspace default, and the last kit can't be deleted. Ask the user first, and pass `confirmed: true` only after they agree.

Kit ids come from find(type='brand_kits'). get_design_guide({brand_kit_id}) reads a kit in full.

add.description: fill: logos and/or reference_images to add beside the kit's own.

confirmed.description: delete: true only after the user agreed to delete this kit.

kit_id.description: The kit; every action but create.

logo_id.description: dark_logo: the kit's light-background logo to make it from.

replace.description: fill: sections that take the site's version; 'palette' is the same as 'colors'.
